_note: Stingerette on-demand service facts, copied from the official PTS page. Re-check each semester: hours and service area change.
name: Stingerette
summary: On-demand shared ride from campus to off-campus residential areas. It no longer runs between on-campus locations: use the Stinger buses for those.
exceptions: No service on Institute holidays or during home football games.
how_to_request: TransLoc app → OnDemand tab (sign in with your GT account).
